expected_rate: once on the first successful Saturday or Sunday weekly post-mortem run
window_reason: The report runs only on Saturday and Sunday mornings; nine calendar days from the ship date always include one full weekend (window_days, post_live_eval 2026-10-16).
reversal: the weekly tier sum differs from realized cash, a co-held lifecycle is attributed to the wrong tier, or an open partial is counted in W/L
